title: Implement Pico and workbench collection controls
goal: Implement the approved shared Pico/browser recording controls, discard flow, configurable reset pose, and reset behavior in the Franka workbench.
doneWhen: Pico and browser controls invoke shared workbench actions and synchronize browser state.
Active recordings can be discarded through the browser or Pico X without deleting another session.
Successful save or discard requests reset, and A+X discards then resets.
An operator can explicitly save a current TCP pose as reset pose and reset uses only that configured pose.
Focused offline tests pass; hardware validation is documented as operator-only.
decisions: The requirement baseline records the approved 2026-10-21 control contract. Pico inputs invoke shared workbench action paths rather than synthetic browser clicks or duplicated recording business logic.
No reset pose is copied from Release: an operator must explicitly save the current TCP pose before reset is available.

verification.summary: All 75 offline tests pass; the implementation was syntax-compiled and no diff whitespace errors remain.
checks: ../robot_capture_franka-franka-feature/.venv/bin/python -m compileall -q app franka main.py tests: passed
limitations: No Pico or Franka hardware action was run. Reset and button mappings require operator-led unloaded, small-workspace validation with emergency stop reachable.
The two skipped tests require scipy in the worker environment.
